instruction: Set all image heights to 16cm on slide 5 and change all text to 38pt on slide 2

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Resize all images on slide 5 to 16cm height and change all text on slide 2 to 38pt. Evaluator requires ALL images to match height and ALL text to match font size (0.5 points each).
metadata.scoring_breakdown: 0.5 for ALL images matching 16cm height, 0.5 for ALL text matching 38pt font size

Text verification logic (slides.py:82-130) correctly extracts all text runs from slide 2 (0-indexed slide 1), checks font size with reasonable tolerance (2.0pt), and requires 100% match (line 124: matching_runs == total_runs).
Postconfig correctly saves the file (Ctrl+S) before evaluation to ensure latest state is captured.
Expected parameter handling is correct: metric receives rules dict directly (no .get('rules') wrapping), properly accesses expected['image_slide_idx'], expected['expected_height_cm'], etc.
Comprehensive edge case handling: missing images/text, out-of-range slide indices, missing font.size attributes all handled with appropriate failure messages.
Scoring breakdown is clear and appropriate: 0.5 points for images, 0.5 points for text, both require 100% match for full credit.
